title: David Mitchell: 4Star Method 1 steps 8–15
instruction: Complete ONLY Method 1 printed steps 8 through 15. The supplied 2:1 rectangle already has the earlier diagonal precreases and holds the downward half-fold in step 8; start by opening it. Include the printed turnover and all fold-and-unfold operations. Stop unfolded after step 15. Blue corresponds to the coloured side. Do not continue step 16 or later. This task is to complete the depicted precrease pattern and finish unfolded on the shown face. It does not require the reference execution order or which half is moved for an otherwise equivalent crease. Extra precreases are permitted; all specified material mountain/valley directions must have been physically formed on the retained paper history. Undo does not count as retaining a crease.
